title: Architecture Fact Model
description: Neutral, generator-independent fact model (the contract between extraction and generation). Draft v1.1 (P7 extension) for the C#/.NET pilot (§16 decision #19). Tiers 1-2 of the §6.0 taxonomy: extracted facts + curated architecture elements, plus the optional POST-V1 deployment facet (§4.4). Validated in CI by validate_facts.py after normalize_facts.py (§10). See plans/2026-06-03-fact-extraction-structurizr-pipeline.md §6.
$comment: VERSIONING (§6.5): schema_version is semver. MINOR = additive-only; this schema keeps the root, target, relationship, component, and code objects OPEN (no additionalProperties:false) so additive MINOR fields still validate, while constraining only the closed enum-valued fields (target type, level, language, evidence.type, confidence, visibility). MAJOR = breaking, ships a new schema file + migrate_facts.py. As of 1.1 (P7) the deployment facet IS defined here as an OPTIONAL top-level `deployment` object (deploy:/infra:/env: node ids; packages/calls/runtime_config edges) and the `deploy`/`runtime_config` evidence kinds + the `native` language are added — all additive, so 1.0 artifacts still validate. Any change to this file requires a schema/CHANGELOG.md entry (CI-enforced, §6.5d).

schema_version.description: Semver of the fact model. This schema validates the 1.x line; a 2.x MAJOR bump ships a separate schema file.

targets.description: Tier-1/2 elements: build targets (containers) with optional child component/code tiers.

relationships.description: Language-agnostic edges. source/target reference target (or child) ids and MAY mix languages (§6.3). May be empty.

deployment.description: OPTIONAL POST-V1 deployment/runtime facet (§4.4, 1.1). Kept strictly distinct from build-time targets/relationships; absent on a build-only run.

confidence.description: Extraction/enrichment confidence (§6.3). Orthogonal to relationship weight.

visibility.description: Link/project_ref visibility (§5/§6.2). Drives the §7.4 down_weight_private knob.

provenance.description: Run provenance. generated_at/commit are excluded from the §18.4 idempotency and drift comparison.

commit.description: Source commit the facts were extracted from.

generated_at.description: Injected by the runner, not the extractor script (§4.3). Excluded from idempotency/drift comparison.

coverage.description: Per-target, per-layer extraction coverage (§11 degradation-aware governance; feeds run-report trust dashboard §10.2). Keys are target ids.

coverageEntry.description: Per-layer coverage for one target. A layer is true/false, or a string like '18/18 files' for partial counts.

target.description: A build target (C4 container altitude). Object stays OPEN for additive MINOR fields (§6.5a).

id.description: STABLE, canonical, content-independent id (§6.3). C# = csharp:csproj:<path-relative-to-repo-root>; C++ = cpp:target:<cmake-target-identity>. Never display-name-derived.

type.description: Build target type. C# projects are 'csproj'; third-party/NuGet shown as boundary is 'package'. 'contract' (1.2) is a shared cross-component interface definition (.proto/IDL/WSDL) modeled as a first-class boundary element (§16#14).

language.description: Extensible via MINOR bump as new extractors land. `native` (1.1) marks an unresolved native library reached via P/Invoke/COM/C++-CLI interop (§16#15). `idl` (1.2) marks a language-neutral shared contract definition (.proto/IDL/WSDL, type 'contract', §16#14).

path.description: Path relative to repo root (e.g. the .csproj folder).

depends_on.description: Convenience list of dependency target ids. The authoritative edge list is relationships[].

package_refs.description: DIRECT package references (NuGet etc.) stamped on the consuming project (1.3). Survives curation's drop_external (which removes the package targets/edges) so the datasheet technology fingerprint stays available (datasheet-enrichment plan §6.1).

responsibilities.description: Optional seed; the LLM enrichment step (§8) may refine.

external.description: Third-party / system-boundary marker (§6.3). May be filtered or promoted to an external system.

tags.description: e.g. build:msbuild, needs-curation, llm-enrich-failed, partial:codegen, external.

components.description: Optional child component tier (§6.0). Rendered only by opt-in drill-down views (§9.1).

conflicts.description: Residual genuine scalar conflicts recorded by normalize_facts.py (§6.4c), surfaced in the curation/drift report; never silently dropped.

component.description: A component within a target. <key> derives from exactly one heuristic per language (C# = namespace), recorded in `source` (§6.3).

id.description: Parent target id + '/component:<key>' (parent-qualified for global uniqueness, §6.3).

source.description: Provenance of the heuristic that produced <key> (e.g. 'namespace' for C#, 'subdir' fallback for C++).

key.description: The raw key (e.g. fully-qualified namespace) before normalization.

code.description: Optional code/class tier (opt-in per component to bound cost, §6.3).

metrics.description: Optional per-target metrics; drive the §9.3 diagnostic views. 1.3 adds the deterministic metrics/1 source counts (datasheet-enrichment plan §3): blank/comment/code line totals, todo_count, the per-language by_language rows, and the versioned `engine` tag so a counting-heuristic change is a reviewable bump, never silent churn.

by_language.description: Per-language rows, sorted by language name (1.3).

relationship.description: A merged edge (§6.4). Identity is (source, target); `kind` is curated later and stays out of identity. Object stays OPEN for additive MINOR fields.

id.description: rel:<source>-><target> (§6.4a). kind is NOT baked in.

kind.description: Curated semantic kind (e.g. 'uses', 'Publishes and consumes messages'). Optional in the pre-curation extracted model; set by curation (§7.4).

weight.description: Aggregated edge INTENSITY from the §6.5 weight function (NOT a raw count, NOT identity). Drives the §7.4 significance threshold for non-declared edges only.

is_declared_dependency.description: True iff any evidence is link/project_ref. Declared deps are NEVER weight-dropped (§7.4).

evidence_strength.description: Optional human-readable rationale, e.g. 'link + include + symbol_use corroborate'.

evidence.description: No relationship without evidence (§5, enforced in Stage 4 & 6).
One concrete corroborating artifact for a relationship (§5). Object open; only `type` is a closed enum (§6.5a).

type.$comment: Evidence kinds. interop is produced by the C#-side P/Invoke + C++/CLI + COM scan (§16#15). runtime (1.2) is produced by the runtime-topology extractor (§5: .NET Aspire AppHost / DI / hosted services) and appears on deployment.edges, never on a build relationship (it must not feed the §6.5 build-edge weight). deploy/runtime_config (§4.4) likewise only appear on deployment.edges.

detail.description: The literal artifact, e.g. '<ProjectReference Include=...>', '#include <...>', a fully-qualified symbol.

count.description: Aggregated occurrence count (e.g. number of includes); summed on merge (§6.4b).

deployment.description: POST-V1 deployment/runtime topology (§4.4, schema 1.1). nodes = deployable images / external infrastructure / environments; edges = packaging (image->build target), runtime calls, and runtime_config references. Strictly distinct from build-time targets/relationships; runtime edges never contribute to the §6.5 build-edge weight.

deploymentNode.description: A deployable image, an external infrastructure component, or an environment (§4.4 / §6.3). Object stays OPEN for additive MINOR fields.

id.description: Content-independent, language-agnostic id (§6.3): deploy:image:<name> | infra:<kind>:<name> (e.g. infra:database:orders-db) | env:<name> (env:dev). Disjoint from cpp:/csharp:.

kind.description: image = deployable container image; infra = external runtime infrastructure (db/queue/ingress/...); env = an environment that scopes a deployment view.

subkind.description: For infra: database|queue|ingress|cache|storage|... For image: the base image. Free-form.

technology.description: e.g. the base image (mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0) or infra technology (PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ).

env.description: The env:<name> this node is scoped to (for per-environment deployment views, §4.4). Absent = all envs.

replicas.description: Declared replica count (k8s Deployment / compose deploy.replicas), if known.

external.description: True for infra outside the system boundary.

deploymentEdge.description: A deployment/runtime edge (§4.4). `packages` links a deploy:image to the build target it ships (binding the runtime node to the build graph); `calls`/`reads`/`publishes` are inter-service runtime edges; runtime_config references config (key, never value, §8.3). Carries deploy/runtime_config evidence.

source.description: A deployment node id, or — for `packages` — a deploy:image id whose target is a build target id.

target.description: A deployment node id or, for `packages`, the cpp:/csharp: build target the image ships.

env.description: The env:<name> this edge is scoped to, if any.

evidence.description: No edge without evidence (§5). Deployment edges carry deploy/runtime_config evidence.
